question: In which part of the leaves do massive amounts of gaseous exchange take place during respiration?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Stomata**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Stomata** are **tiny openings or pores** found on the** surface of leaves and stems**.
 
• They are crucial for gas exchange, allowing the intake of carbon dioxide and the release of oxygen during photos
